messages.subject: Allow user to add tabs
parts:
Hello,

How do I allow the user to create extra tabs (with widgets) by clicking on a button?  Currently, the only method I have seen involves re-creating every tab, which will also reset the value of all the widgets.  Is there a way to avoid this issue, without losing the ability to set the default value that the select input widgets will be set to?

Thanks.
